comment: Bell as the engine's gate (the owner, 2026-10-01, 06:55 and 07:10: Bell is built as a gate, two simple worlds show the engine works; ALGEBRA.md #the-click-is-the-meeting, the pair's form; HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate): every number of the four worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, their mode files (tools/pixel_mode.py, the message lay, with --modes) and the blind expectation file, derived from the settings before any run and never touched after. One chain of `length` Nodes (y and z folded) on the universe file `universe` (examples/events/light.json with the pair family added, light's pair at the dimension [2, 1], two real lines never summed at a Node); the pair laid as one event at the column `source`, two messages of the pair family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8) toward +x and -x with the raised-cosine edge `edge_along` along x at the amplitude `amplitude`, the lay the same on both parts (the symmetric lay, UU + LL); one beam to each side, each to one declared region of `screen` Nodes, the chain's first and last, backed by the receding face `receding` (opaque: what enters leaves the declared board and never returns); the side a's region `left` and the side b's `right`, each declaring its setting as its `basis` (p, q) and the pair's `pattern` [[1, 0], [0, 1]] (one integer pair per part, the + port reading the part k as alpha_k p + beta_k q and the - port as alpha_k (-q) + beta_k p: the parts read as (p, q) and (-q, p)); the four worlds the four pairs of `settings`, a and a' on the left, b and b' on the right; `ticks` intervals, the reading over `window`, the whole passage. The reading (tools/bell_gate.py): the engine's `parts` lines, per interval and region the parts' signed level sums, paired through the root and squared, the joint share J over the window on both members of the level pair, E per world, S over the four, the marginal, one pair drawn by the shares with `seed`; beside it the two local credits as the fence (by the parts' shares and by the sign) and the local sums, from the same reports, and r and rho, the parts' mismatch, LATTICE diagnostics never in the blind.
